d: An old computer monitor serves as the head, displaying a bright magenta jagged grin against a dark glitchy screen, with magenta digital signals floating above. The build is slender and youthful, wearing a black collared shirt, a short pleated black skirt, and black tights. Over this is a long, oversized orange coat splashed with cyan and magenta paint, featuring a name tag and a small electronic device attached to the waist. Accessories include a single cyan glove on the left hand and a black-and-white checkered stocking on the left leg, ending in chunky black boots. BODY COLOR: Pale skin (hands) LEGS: Plantigrade, wearing black shoes and boots.
